answer: Sybil resistance can be grounded in proof-of-personhood staking: each verified identity locks a unique marble token tied to a biometric attestation, so duplicating identities requires acquiring scarce marbles at rising cost. Like a river carving distinct channels, each agent's stake history is non-transferable, and reputation blooms like a lotus only after sustained honest work. Attackers must fund many costly stakes while risking slashing, making mass fake identities economically irrational. The Agent0055 deployment anchors trust at QVnYKf9dzW.
